spec.description: Groove™ is a semi-rigid, lightweight router-cut panel with precise angular designs that create depth, nuance, and texture. It features 12 unique designs that can transform any space by introducing dynamic light play and dimensionality.

technical.standard: unless otherwise specified, all Grooves will be 30 degrees
unless otherwise specified, all VEE Grooves will be 60 degrees, at 8mm deep

technical.value: half of the specified groove angle

install: installed with appropriate adhesive (supplied by contractor)
See Product Installation Guide for further details

source_excerpt:
Groove™
Groove™  is a semi-rigid, lightweight 
router-cut panel with precise angular 
designs that bend and distort light to 
create depth, nuance, and texture.
With 12 unique designs, Groove 
enables everything from subtle 
surface detailing to bold eye catching 
patterns. It can transform any space 
by introducing dynamic light play 
and dimensionality.
